login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Sign in with the account created by your admin.
login.errorLocked: Too many attempts. The account is temporarily locked; try again in {{seconds}} seconds.
login.errorRateLimited: Too many requests from this network. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.
login.errorDisabled: This account is disabled. Contact your admin.
login.errorNetwork: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

totp.title: Two-step verification
totp.hint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app for the account {{username}}.
totp.recoveryHint: Enter one of the recovery codes for the account {{username}}. Each code works once.
totp.invalid: Wrong or expired code. Try the latest code from the app.
totp.invalidRecovery: Wrong or already used recovery code.
totp.rateLimited: Too many code attempts. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.
totp.noCodesLeft: That was your last recovery code. Generate new codes in your profile.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.subtitleRequired: The temporary password must be changed before continuing.
changePassword.subtitle: Other sessions are signed out automatically after the change.

errors.common: This password is too common, choose another
errors.contains_username: The password must not contain the username
errors.same_as_current: Must differ from the current password
errors.same_as_initial: Must differ from the initial password

profile.title: Profile & preferences
profile.passwordHint: After the change every other session is signed out.

twofa.title: Two-step verification (2FA)
twofa.since: On since {{date}}. Every sign-in asks for a code from your authenticator app.
twofa.description: Protect the account with a 6-digit code from an authenticator app (TOTP) in addition to the password.

setup.title: Turn on two-step verification
setup.subtitle: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app (e.g. Aegis, Google Authenticator, 1Password), then enter the 6-digit code it shows for {{appName}}.
setup.qrLabel: QR code for the authenticator app
setup.manual: Cannot scan? Enter this key manually:

codes.title: Save your recovery codes
codes.subtitle: These codes are shown only once. Use one if you lose your phone; each code works once.
codes.regenerated: The old codes no longer work. The new codes are shown only once.
codes.intro: Store them in a password manager or print them and keep them somewhere safe.
codes.fileHeader: 2FA recovery codes for account {{username}} — each code works once.

disableDialog.title: Turn off two-step verification
disableDialog.subtitle: Enter your password and a code from the app (or a recovery code). The old recovery codes stop working once 2FA is off.

regenDialog.title: New recovery codes
regenDialog.subtitle: Ten new codes are generated and every old code is cancelled. Enter your password to continue.

errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.confirmOne: That device has to sign in again.
sessions.confirmOthers: Every other device has to sign in again. This session stays.
